## Professional Profile

Nguyễn Hữu Lợi is an educator, researcher, and academic practitioner with interdisciplinary training in sustainability management, business administration, and natural resource management.

His work focuses on research analytics, quantitative methods, structural equation modelling, sustainable development, climate-smart agriculture, academic writing, and reproducible research.

## Research Interests

### Data Science and Analytics

- Statistical Modelling
- Predictive Analytics
- Data Visualization
- Research Analytics

### Research Methods

- PLS-SEM
- Structural Equation Modelling
- Meta-analysis
- Bibliometric Analysis
- Reproducible Research

### Sustainability and Development

- Climate-Smart Agriculture
- Sustainable Livelihoods
- Low-Carbon Rice Production
- Participatory Innovation Systems

## Current Positions

- Head of Specialty Department, FPT PolySchool
- PhD Candidate, Asian Institute of Technology (AIT)
- Researcher, Mekong Delta Development Research Institute (MDI)
- Project Secretary, BOLD-RICE Vietnam

## Purpose of This Course

This course was developed to help lecturers and researchers move beyond software operation and develop the ability to:

- Understand analytical logic
- Select appropriate methods
- Interpret results correctly
- Produce publication-ready outputs
- Conduct reproducible research
